definitions: A solitaire card game played with a single deck of 52 cards, where all cards are dealt face-up into eight columns, and the goal is to move all cards to four foundation piles, building them up by suit from Ace to King, utilizing four open 'free cells' for temporary storage.
examples: I spent hours playing FreeCell on my computer.
The strategy for FreeCell involves careful planning.
She finally won a difficult game of FreeCell.
